blocks.text: Atomic spectra ki buniyad yeh hai ke spectrometer se quantized photons ki particle wali fitrat ka saboot milta hai. Tajurbe mein discharge tube, spectrometer aur diffraction grating hoti hai (Fig. 18.9): discharge tube ki roshni tang slit aur collimator se guzar kar parallel (mutawazi) hoti hai, grating par parti hai, aur ghoomne wali telescope se dekhi jati hai.

blocks.alt: Discharge tube ki roshni lens se tang jhiri (narrow slit) par jama hoti; collimator use mutawazi (parallel) banata aur yeh vernier angle scale wali mez ke beech diffraction grating par parti hai. Mudi hui (diffracted) rangein ghoomne wali telescope mein jati hain jise eyepiece se dekha jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.9: diffraction grating se bana spectrum (kitab ki Figure 18.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Roshni ki har wavelength apne zaviye par mudti (diffract hoti) hai, is liye telescope ghumane se spectrum ki lakeerein andheri pasmanzar (background) par aik aik kar ke nazar aati hain aur un ke zaviye scale par parhe jate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein roshni ke source par 'Beam of electrons' likha hai, jo ghalat hai; matan ke mutabiq source discharge tube hai, is liye hum ne 'Discharge tube' likha hai.

Spectrometer ke eyepiece se andheri pas-e-manzar (dark background) par roshan lakeeron ka silsila nazar aata hai. Mukhtalif elements ke vapours (bhaap) aisi lakeeron ke alag alag patterns dete hain jinhein spectral series kehte hain; in se elements pehchane ja sakte hain. Aisi ek series J. J. Balmer ne 1885 mein atomic hydrogen ke spectrum mein pehchani (Fig. 18.10). Yeh electromagnetic spectrum ke nazar aane wale (visible) hisse mein hai aur is ki chaar lakeerein hain: 656 nm (laal), 486 nm (neeli-sabz), 434 nm (neeli) aur 410 nm (violet). J. R. Rydberg ne in nataij ko yeh formula diya:

blocks.alt: Andheri patti par hydrogen ki rangeen lakeerein: 656 nm (surkh), 486 nm (neeli-sabz), 434 nm (neeli) aur 410 nm (banafshi), aur UV ki taraf do aur halki banafshi lakeerein.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: atomic hydrogen ke spectrum mein Balmer series (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Balmer formula ke baen taraf h/λ chhapti hai; Rydberg formula mein 1/λ hota hai: 1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²), n = 3, 4, 5, ...

Yahan n electron ki excited energy level hai jis ki values 3, 4, 5, ... hain, aur R_H Rydberg constant hai jis ki value 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹ hai. Hydrogen ki spectral lakeerein na-nazar aane wale ultraviolet (UV) aur infrared (IR) hisson mein bhi hain. UV mein Lyman series ki wavelengths yeh formula deta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Eq. 18.12 ko h/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²) chhapti hai, jo Balmer wala formula hi hai. Lyman series n = 1 par khatam hoti hai, is liye sahi 1/λ = R_H(1/1² − 1/n²) hai, n = 2, 3, 4, ... (kitab ki n ki values bhi isi se milti hain).

blocks.alt: Amudi patti jis mein wavelength neeche ki taraf barhti hai. Oopar Lyman series (91 se 122 nm) ki surkh lakeerein, phir Balmer series (365 se 656 nm), phir 820 nm se neeche Paschen series.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: atomic hydrogen ka line spectrum; sirf Balmer series electromagnetic spectrum ke nazar aane wale hisse mein hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har series ki lakeerein aik had (series limit) ki taraf ghani hoti jati hain: Lyman 91 nm, Balmer 365 nm aur Paschen 820 nm par. Lyman UV mein, Balmer nazar aane wali roshni mein (656 se 410 nm) aur Paschen infrared mein hai.
IR mein spectral lakeeron ki wavelengths:
Yahan n = 4, 5, 6, ... Is series ko Paschen series kehte hain. Energy levels Fig. 18.11 mein aur mukhtalif transitions (chhalangein) Fig. 18.12 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar ufqi lakeerein aur oopar ki taraf Energy ka teer: sab se neeche ground state E0 (n = 1), us ke oopar excited states E1 (n = 2), E2 (n = 3) aur E3 (n = 4).
blocks.caption: Figure 18.11: energy levels (kitab ki Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Hydrogen ke energy levels n = 1 se 7 aur la-mehdood (infinity), Energy/10^-19 J mehwar par (paimane ke mutabiq nahi): -21.8, -5.45, -2.42, -1.36, -0.86 aur 0.00. n = 2, 3, 4, 5 se n = 1 tak teer Lyman series; n = 3, 4, 5, 6 se n = 2 tak Balmer series; n = 4, 5, 6, 7 se n = 3 tak Paschen series.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.12: hydrogen atom mein mukhtalif transitions (kitab ki Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer oopar wale level se neeche wale level par electron ki chhalang hai, aur photon ki tawanai dono levels ka farq hai. Surkh (pink) teer 656 nm aur neela teer 486 nm Balmer lakeer hai. Kitab ki shakal mein Balmer ka teesra teer dobara n = 4 se shuru hota hai; durust n = 5 hai, is liye hum ne Balmer teer n = 3, 4, 5, 6 se n = 2 tak banaye hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: 1/λ = R_H(1/p² − 1/n²). Electron jis level par aa kar rukta hai woh p hai: Lyman p = 1 (UV), Balmer p = 2 (visible), Paschen p = 3 (IR). n hamesha p se bara hota hai.

Yeh equations akele (isolated) hydrogen atom mein electron ki ijazat wali (allowed) energies batati hain. n = 1 wali halat ground state hai, aur n = 2, 3, 4, ... excited states hain. Atom sirf alag alag (discrete) miqdar mein energy jazb karta hai aur kisi excited state mein chala jata hai. Excited states bohat kam der rehti hain; electron jald neeche wali level par wapas aata hai aur photon kharij karta hai. Yeh photons kai spectral lakeeron wale emission spectrum ki shakal mein nazar aate hain.

Jab continuous spectrum wali roshni (jaise safed roshni) kam pressure wali gas se guzaar kar us ka spectrum dekhein, to kuch khaas wavelengths ki roshni ghaib milti hai aur un ki jagah andheri lakeerein hoti hain. Aise spectrum ko absorption spectrum kehte hain. Gas se guzarte waqt electrons khaas miqdar ki energy jazb kar ke oopar ki energy levels par chale jate hain. Sirf woh photons jazb hote hain jin ki energy bilkul utni ho jitni is chhalang ke liye chahiye. Jab yeh excited electrons neeche aate hain to unhi khaas wavelengths ke photons kharij hote hain, jo emission spectrum mein nazar aate hain. Yani absorption spectrum se ghaib wavelengths wahi hain jo usi element ke emission spectrum mein maujood hain (Fig. 18.13).

blocks.alt: 400 se 750 nm scale par teen pattiyan: (a) musalsal spectrum, banafshi se surkh tak poori rangon ki patti; (b) hydrogen emission spectrum, kaali patti par taqreeban 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par roshan lakeerein; (c) hydrogen absorption spectrum, rangon ki patti jis mein inhi wavelengths par andheri lakeerein.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: aik hi element ke absorption aur emission spectrum ka talluq: (a) safed roshni ka spectrum, (b) element ka emission spectrum, (c) usi element ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gas bilkul wahi wavelengths jazb karti hai jo kharij kar sakti hai, kyunke dono unhi energy levels ke joron ke darmiyan chhalangon se aati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka caption hissa (b) ko absorption aur hissa (c) ko emission spectrum kehta hai, lekin panels par ulat likha hai (b emission, c absorption); panels ke label durust hain. Kitab ke wavelength scale par bhi ghalti hai: '400 ... 650, 650, 700' chhapa hai; durust 400 se 750 nm (har 50 nm) hai, aur hum ne yahi banaya hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atom ko excite karne ke liye photon ki energy do shells (levels) ki energy ke farq ke bilkul barabar honi chahiye: hf = Eₙ − Eₚ. Lekin electron agar atom se takraye to woh atom ko tab bhi excite kar sakta hai jab us ki K.E. is farq ke barabar ya zyada ho (bachi hui energy electron ke paas reh jati hai).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Spectra teen qisam ke hote hain: continuous spectrum (saari rangein lagataar), line spectrum (andheri patti par alag alag roshan lakeerein, jaise garam gas ke atoms) aur band spectrum (paas paas lakeeron ke guchhe, jo molecules dete hain).
